layers.name: L0_admission
layers.notes: one record, two co-located axle-box vertical channels, no excitation log and no profile truth

layers.name: L1_registration
layers.notes: the two axle-box channels are co-located; the mileage axis is the integrated speed, which is why the section boundaries only agree with the paper to a few metres

layers.name: L2_calibration
layers.notes: one table per recorded speed, no interpolation between them; the four passes agree on wavelength to 11.3 % while their line frequency scales with speed (398 -> 713 Hz), which is what a table keyed by speed has to show before L3 may use it

layers.name: L3_inversion
layers.notes: peak frequencies are reproducible across sections, but a peak is not a depth: no amplitude was recovered from this record, so the inversion here is spectral only

layers.name: L4_uncertainty
layers.notes: held out one pass at a time: the wavelength interval covers 2 of 4 at one sigma and 4 of 4 at two sigma, so the criterion passes at its weakest possible margin (0.50 against a 0.50 bar, binomial tail 0.379) and four folds refute calibration rather than establish it; the all-window median instead misses two sigma at a 3.06-sigma fold, so the in-band median is the defensible speed-independent observable and the all-window one has a fat tail.  The estimator's own spread between two same-class records is 0.5-2.0 dB per band, comparable to the entire +/-2 dB budget, so a band amplitude here needs averaging over records that this dataset does not contain

layers.name: L5_acceptance
layers.notes: 3 of 6 sections detected against a 6 of 6 bar; detection at that level is real but the amplitude and profile claims are withdrawn

measurement_validation_meaning: a detector reproduces the recorded sections, but no amplitude or profile claim holds
degradation: amplitude and depth claims withdrawn: a single steady speed, so the rail spectrum cannot be separated from the vehicle transfer
modal calibration blocked: Cov-SSI did not converge and FDD ridges cannot be attributed without a second steady speed
the curve with cant stays refused: balance cant needs the vehicle frame tilted, and the geometry route keeps gravity along world z
